'''Varo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served as a military adviser and combat instructor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During his career, he served as an instructor to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].
